verdict.rationale: Convex's own docs say it ships client libraries, list official language support (JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin, Rust) and integrations for major frameworks, and offer the first-party Convex Auth library. missing for 10: per-SDK reference documentation or depth evidence (e.g., feature parity across languages), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Convex provides a database, a place to write your server functions, and client libraries.
Using your favorite languages: JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin, Rust
Using your favorite frameworks: React, Next.js, Remix, TanStack Start, React Native, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Node.js, Bun
For client-side React and React Native mobile apps you can implement auth directly in Convex with the Convex Auth library.
